After a reload at the session-ended form, B continued the reopened sale and the till said "Display connection: Another till is using this station. A manager can take it over. The team can continue using this screen." until about 70 s after the end, when the display followed: the ended session's own lease, said as another till (the till's note of its own lease is memory only).

In the held minute the customer display keeps the ended person's last screen: with a QR waiting it kept showing "Scan to Pay ฿1040" with a live QR while B's till showed no payment in progress (h1c); without a QR it kept "Please pay ฿1040" (point 1).

Point 2 with the harness's 0.6 s offline blip right before the till heard the end (the SCRUM-878 method): the family line never showed; one status read (401) and the watch stopped. Heard the till's own way (no blip) it shows. A park network blip at the end moment would lose the line.
